classes.description_text: Unstoppable in the thick of it. Huge health, cleaving swings, and every kill feeds the fury.
Holy ground and righteous hammers. Heals himself, shrugs off death once in a while.
Death from range. Arrows, traps and volleys, as long as you keep your distance.
Fast, fragile and lethal. The quickest hero, with crits that delete elites.
Light and Shadow. Shields and heals keep you alive while pain spreads through the horde.
Storms that jump from foe to foe, and totems that fight beside you.
The glass cannon. The biggest area damage in Azeroth, and nothing to hide behind.
Curses and fire. Damage over time stacks up on everything that chases you.
Moon, storm and growth. Roots, hurricanes and the steadiest self-healing.

baseline.purpose: Historical declaration comparison only; new bounds and records never use old table constants.

field_interpretation.raw_layout: All88B retained as raw_hex/22u32; declaration lists and strings followed through pointers in reconstructed memory.
field_interpretation.numeric_labels: Historical descriptive field names retained for comparison. Their offsets/bit patterns are exact; all latest gameplay consumers are not semantically recovered.
field_interpretation.execution_kind_u8: Raw record byte84; no claim that every variant behavior is recovered.
field_interpretation.school_code_u8: Raw record byte85; school names intentionally not inferred from strings.
field_interpretation.effect_tag_u32: Raw word at0; union parameters at4/8 remain exact raw bits plus float interpretation.
field_interpretation.class_description_text: Pointer/length at64/68, included here in addition to the historical report fields.

limitations: These are initial static declarations, not observed runtime mutations or a proof of all114 ability behaviors.
A class kit is a declaration list, not proof of unlock eligibility, talent/proc ordering or every gameplay path.
rockbiter is outside the nine declared class kits; this does not prove it is unreachable or inactive.
Numeric labels are historical descriptive names; school/execution/effect values are retained raw without guessing enum names.
No game/module instantiation, networking, saves, binary patch, commit or push is performed.
